title: TIRON TRV 10P Robotic Vacuum Cleaner, 2-in-1 Mop, Laser Navigation, 5000 Pa Suction
rating: 4.04.0 out of 5 stars(14)4.0 out of 5 stars
description: Advanced LiDAR Laser Navigation accurately maps your home in real time and follows an intelligent zig-zag cleaning path for maximum coverage. Stores up to 4 floor maps, making it ideal for duplexes and multi-storey homes. Combines powerful 5000Pa suction and intelligent mopping to remove dust, debris, pet hair, and daily dirt from tiles, marble, wooden floors, and carpets. Includes a 300ml water tank with adjustable water flow for efficient mopping. Control cleaning anytime through the mobile app. Set schedules, select cleaning modes, view maps, customize cleaning zones, and monitor progress remotely. Compatible with Alexa and Google Assistant for hands-free operation. Supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi connectivity. Create No-Go Zones and Virtual Walls through the app to prevent cleaning in sensitive areas such as prayer rooms, pet zones, children’s play areas, or areas with loose wires and rugs. Equipped with anti-fall, anti-collision, carpet detection, and obstacle-climbing technology to navigate furniture, door thresholds, edges, and carpets safely. Automatically boosts suction on carpets for deeper cleaning. High-capacity battery delivers up to 180 minutes of runtime, suitable for homes up to 2000 sq. ft. When battery runs low, the robot automatically returns to the charging dock and resumes cleaning from where it stopped. Choose from Auto, Spot, Edge, Turbo and Quiet Cleaning modes to match different cleaning requirements, from daily maintenance to focused cleaning of high-dust areas. Built specifically for Indian household conditions with powerful dust pickup, efficient corner cleaning, mixed-floor compatibility, and reliable performance for everyday cleaning needs. Includes free virtual demo, installation guidance, service assistance, and easy spare-part availability backed by TIRON’s reliable Pan-India support network.
